overall_summary: The historical dataset is very small, with overall view counts consistently under 20 and zero engagement across all posts. Confidence is low, meaning we cannot definitively isolate a high-converting format yet. However, slight variations show that relationship-based and memory-related hooks performed marginally better (15-17 views), while complex night-time/overthinking angles struggled more.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'आज भी फोन में तुम्हारा नाम सुरक्षित है' (A_eLARoegnw) and 'नंबर पर अभी भी तेरी तस्वीर है' (a9-G1X5jEOU) yielded the highest relative views (17 and 15 respectively).
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on tangible, modern objects of nostalgia like phone contacts, photos, and chat screens.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract or overly broad night/overthinking hooks
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'आधी रात को खाली चैट देखना' (WvZxup1LQYo) got 0 views, and general time-based hooks underperformed.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid starting with vague time markers or purely atmospheric statements without a concrete emotional anchor.
